answer: Resist sybils with proof-of-useful-work: each identity must complete a fresh public-good computation, such as protein folding or climate modeling, and publish a verifiable result each epoch. A crystal-clear ledger records every contribution, so ten thousand clones sharing one machine produce one signal of work, not ten thousand. An attacker minting a nebula of fakes must run ten thousand real computations, paying hardware and power per fake, while an honest agent contributes one useful job and keeps its standing.
